task_title: The master-doc fill runner selects on a marker no fill writes
task_criteria: 1. Selector reads a completion marker the runner itself writes on a successful fill; on a fully filled tree a fresh run prints todo=0 and changes no file (quote before/after run output and the marker name). 2. Two consecutive runs on a filled tree are idempotent: exit 0 and no byte change in the module tree (AGENTS.md rule 5). 3. Non-module files (docs/master/00-INDEX.md) are excluded from the module glob by a guard, with the match shown today and the guard that stops it. 4. The NARRATION rule returns 0 hits over docs/master, quoting the grep and its count. 5. bash tests/selftest.sh prints SELFTEST: PASS and bash docs/audits/cf198-section-mapping.sh prints RESULT: OK at the closing commit. 6. The module root is overridable so a fixture tree can drive the selector, and a selftest arm proves the selector can fail (a RED module is selected) and go green (a filled module is not). 7. scripts/master_doc_fill.py stays clean: ruff check and ruff format --check both pass on it.
